title: EMA states the ABEL cap as a limit pair; the formula at CVwR = 50% gives a fractionally wider one
status_note: RESOLVED means the question is answered, not that the numbers converged. EMA states the maximum widened range as 69.84 - 143.19% and its table gives the >=50% row as exactly that pair; PowerTOST preserves the unrounded formula. That is a documented divergence between an oracle and a regulator - not a regulatory ambiguity, and not a be-stats defect. The 0.0032 percentage-point difference is permanent and will appear in every run.

ema_stated.source: EMA, Guideline on the Investigation of Bioequivalence, CPMP/EWP/QWP/1401/98 Rev. 1, section 4.1.10, and its own table row '>=50 | 69.84 | 143.19'
ema_stated.kind: normative, stated as a pair of numbers

computed_at_cap_cv.rule: cap CVwR at 50% and evaluate exp(+/- k*sWR)
computed_at_cap_cv.source: PowerTOST 1.5-7, R/scABEL.R: ret <- ifelse(CV>CVcap, exp(r_const*CV2se(CVcap)), ret)

what_differs.relative_magnitude: about three parts in a hundred thousand

which_be_stats_applies: The stated pair. `ema_abel_limits` caps each limit at 69.84 and 143.19; `spec.ema_abel_cap_computed()` returns the derived pair, kept for comparison and never used in place of it.
why: Consistency with how this package has treated every such question. FDA states sWR >= 0.294 where the derivation gives 0.293560 and be-stats follows the stated number (VAL-FDA-HVD-002). FDA's NTI appendix states Delta = 1/0.9 where its own example code writes 1.11111 and be-stats follows the stated constant. The rule applied is the one the regulator wrote down; a value that reproduces it to the published precision is recorded beside it, not substituted for it.
side_effects: The stated pair is fractionally NARROWER than the formula's value, so this reading is the marginally more conservative one.
The cap engages at CVwR of about 49.993% rather than exactly 50%, because the stated lower limit 69.84 is reached just before CVwR = 50%.

consequence_for_tier_3.prediction: A scABEL comparison agrees EXACTLY for CVwR below the cap and differs by 0.00322 (lower) and 0.00102 (upper) percentage points at or above it.
consequence_for_tier_3.how_the_cases_handle_it: The below-cap case uses a tolerance at floating-point scale. The capped case asserts the divergence IS the predicted one rather than widening a tolerance to absorb it. A difference predicted in advance is evidence that both implementations are understood; the same difference found afterwards would be a finding.

why_it_still_qualifies_the_tier_3_row: Resolved is not absent. The divergence is permanent - it will appear in every run for as long as EMA prints a rounded pair and PowerTOST recomputes it - so the ema_hvd_abel tier-3 row reads PASSED_WITH_FINDING rather than PASSED. The qualification records that the comparison is not unconditional; the RESOLVED status records that nobody needs to investigate it again. Those are different facts and the report carries both.
what_would_reopen_it: EMA restating the cap - for example in the future ICH M13C - or a PowerTOST release that adopts the stated pair. Neither is an action for this package.
action_required: None in be-stats. Revisit if EMA restates the cap, for example in the future ICH M13C.
